rv.q: Using the most minimal means, the playwright Samuel D. Hunter achieves mightily powerful effects.
For Metcalf, director Joe Mantello's exceptional Steppenwolf world premiere production is a career highlight in a career of highlights.

Director Joe Mantello brings Samuel D. Hunter’s (The Whale, A Case for the Existence of God) new family comedy-drama Little Bear Ridge Road to Steppenwolf. Tony and Emmy-winning actor Laurie Metcalf leads the small cast with a compelling performance.

cn.t: Hunter's soul-wrenching family drama about estranged relatives settling an estate earns strong praise, with Metcalf and Stock delivering powerhouse performances that bring out the best in each other.
